schema.name: run_id
schema.description: The sweep that evaluated this trajectory; also the retry cleanup key.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: Observed agent. Every read filters on it.

schema.name: trajectory_id
schema.description: The conversation this row is about: a session id where the sweep judged a whole session, an invocation/trace id where it judged one turn. The same value the findings and their occurrences carry.

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: When the sweep recorded it. Partition column.

schema.name: source
schema.description: Telemetry source the trajectory was ingested from: big_query, cloud_ops or cloud_logging.

schema.name: source_session_id
schema.description: Session a single-turn trajectory belongs to, so a reader can walk from one turn to the conversation around it.

schema.name: source_trace_ids
schema.description: Cloud Trace ids this trajectory is made of, in chronological order -- one per turn for a whole session, one in total for a single turn. The first is the conversation's opening turn, which is what a console link uses. Empty for big_query, which carries no trace ids.

schema.name: ingest_status
schema.description: What ingestion made of it: ingested (assembled whole), partial (built from incomplete telemetry, so weaker as evidence), or not_ingested (sampled but unusable -- unparseable telemetry, or no conversation content). The last is what explains a sample smaller than the run's budget.
